Module io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations
Package io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.callbacks

Annotation Interface Callback

@Target({FIELD,METHOD,PARAMETER,TYPE,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Repeatable(Callbacks.class) @Inherited public @interface Callback
The annotation may be used at method level to add one ore more callbacks to the operation definition.
